def generate(s):
    p = s.primitives()
    quat = p['top_down_quat'](0.0)

        return p['move_ee'](pos, quat, speed=speed, tol=tol, settle=settle)

    move([0.59, 0.0, 0.29])

    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUTPUT / 'trajectory.npz', meta={

    })

    print(json.dumps({'actions': len(actions), 'status': status}), flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    session = Session('mustard_in_left_bin', instance='/app/instance.json')
